caption: Products at or below the low-stock threshold (default 5), lowest stock first.

caption: New --stats view: min, median, mean and max unit price for each category and overall.

caption: The Windows console portal opens with Admin, Vendor and Customer entry points.

title: Admin dashboard
caption: Admin login reaches the dashboard, now with the Inventory Insights option.

title: Admin inventory insights
caption: New native report: category medians and values, low-stock alerts and a restock estimate.

title: Vendor product ownership
caption: A vendor sees only the products it owns, with price and stock.

title: Browsing the grocery catalog
caption: Customers browse a category with live prices and stock read from the data files.

caption: Adding Apples twice merges into one line (qty 3); Milk is a second line with its own total.

caption: 2 Apples: PKR 300.00 subtotal + 15.00 tax + 15.00 delivery = PKR 330.00, then the order is saved.

caption: The order log gains the new order and Apples stock drops from 20 to 18.

title: Persistent wishlist
caption: Wishlist items are saved per customer and survive logout.

title: Domain correctness checks
caption: 17 checks: money parsing, rounding, malformed rows, unsafe names and rollback cleanup.

title: Analytics test suite
caption: 30 new checks for statistics, filters, sorting, restock plans, quotes, discounts and CSV.

caption: Unit checks for cart merging, stock rules and category-gated product operations.

title: Integration scenarios
caption: Nine piped-input scenarios run the real executable in temporary fixtures.

title: CMake and CTest run
caption: All CTest targets pass, including CLI quote, statistics and overselling checks.

title: Complete-record parsing
caption: Parsing uses the final separators, so names like T-shirts survive, and validates every field.

caption: Integer-paisa arithmetic: tax and delivery are rounded half up without overflow.

caption: Checkout stages every file, keeps backups and restores them if any step fails.

title: Quote builder with stock checks
caption: Analytics.h merges repeated items, rejects unknown or ambiguous names and checks stock.

title: Inventory insights source
caption: The admin report reuses the analytics layer and never writes to data files.

caption: The webpage loads the C++ catalog export: search, filter, sort and add items to the cart.
